title: Floor 1 concept-art studies

scope.description: Concept-art coverage for known visited, mentioned, and reusable generic Floor 1 places in Dungeon Crawler Carl. This is not an exhaustive atlas or a claim that each panel is a separate named canon location.
scope.visualDirection: Consistent top-down GBA-inspired pixel art; orthogonal square architecture and square floors. Never use diamond grids or isometric projection.
scope.artBoundary: Concept art adapts prose details into illustrative compositions. Layouts, dimensions, connecting geometry, and details not directly described are inferred and must not be presented as canonical floorplans. No Book 2 locations or characters are in scope.

projection: Mixed camera views: overhead room studies and frontal passages; orthogonal square architecture does not make these strict overhead gameplay maps.
status: static concept art; no gameplay integration; not seamless tiles

provenance.claim: All six sources visually reviewed by coordinator. Book 1 Floor 1 anchors come from coverage references; layouts, compositions, object placement and monster interpretation are inferred. No tile or runtime integration.
